summary: A capable agent with good tools and explicit checkpoints may outperform a workforce by avoiding communication loss and correlated self-review.

points.text: Organization metaphors can introduce performative meetings and role messages that consume tokens without adding information or independent evidence.
Parallel agents often read the same incomplete context and repeat the same mistake, so apparent consensus is not statistical independence.
Specialized configurations increase prompt, model, permission and evaluation surfaces that must be versioned and maintained.
